  function locals(b){const p={i:0},n=read(b,p),types=[];for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const count=read(b,p),type=b[p.i++];if(count>10000)throw Error('Invalid local count');for(let k=0;k<count;k++)types.push(type);}return {end:p.i,types};}
  function patchPlannerBody(old,hook) {
    const pre=Uint8Array.from(hook.pre),post=Uint8Array.from(hook.post),before=locals(old),prefix=locals(pre),suffix=locals(post);
    const expected=hook.originalTypes.map(t=>({i32:127,f32:125,f64:124}[t]));
    if(before.types.length!==expected.length || before.types.some((t,i)=>t!==expected[i]) || prefix.types.length!==hook.totalLocals || suffix.types.length!==hook.totalLocals || old[old.length-1]!==11)
      throw Error('Native corner planner layout changed.');
    return join(pre.subarray(0,pre.length-1),old.subarray(before.end,old.length-1),post.subarray(suffix.end));
  }
  function patchCornerBody(old){return patchPlannerBody(old,CORNER);}
  function patchBrakingBody(old){return patchPlannerBody(old,BRAKING);}
  async function patchBytes(input) {
    const bytes=input instanceof Uint8Array ? input : new Uint8Array(input);
    const profile=profileForSize(bytes.length);
    if(!profile)throw Object.assign(Error('Game module size changed. Native AI disabled.'),{patchCode:'module-size'});
    const hash=Array.from(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',bytes)),b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
    if(hash!==profile.hash)throw Object.assign(Error('Game module changed. Native AI disabled.'),{patchCode:'module-hash',moduleHash:hash});
    if(profile!==LEGACY)return patchCurrent(bytes,profile);
    const p={i:8};let output=null;
    while(p.i<bytes.length){
      const start=p.i,id=bytes[p.i++],size=read(bytes,p),bodyStart=p.i,end=bodyStart+size;
      if(end>bytes.length)throw Error('Invalid module section');
      if(id===10){
        const n=read(bytes,p),pieces=[bytes.subarray(bodyStart,p.i)];let changed=0;
        for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
          const sizeAt=p.i,bodyLen=read(bytes,p),fnStart=p.i,fnEnd=fnStart+bodyLen;
          if(fnEnd>end)throw Error('Invalid game function');
          if(i===BRAKING.index-37){
            const fn=patchBrakingBody(bytes.subarray(fnStart,fnEnd));pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(i===CORNER.index-37){
            const fn=patchCornerBody(bytes.subarray(fnStart,fnEnd));pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(i===TARGET){
            const old=bytes.subarray(fnStart,fnEnd),a=locals(old),b=locals(BRIDGE);
            if(a.types.length!==31 || b.types.length!==64 || a.types.some((v,k)=>v!==b.types[k]) || old[old.length-1]!==11 || BRIDGE[BRIDGE.length-1]!==11)
              throw Error('Native AI hook layout changed.');
            const fn=join(BRIDGE.subarray(0,BRIDGE.length-1),old.subarray(a.end));
            pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(i===PACE_TARGET){
            const old=bytes.subarray(fnStart,fnEnd);
            if(locals(old).types.length!==1 || old[old.length-1]!==11 || PACE[PACE.length-1]!==11)
              throw Error('Native AI pace hook layout changed.');
            pieces.push(leb(PACE.length),PACE);changed++;
          }else if(i===WALL_TARGET){
            const old=bytes.subarray(fnStart,fnEnd),a=locals(old),b=locals(WALL);
            if(a.types.length!==1 || a.types[0]!==127 || b.types.length!==19 || b.types[0]!==127 || old[old.length-1]!==11 || WALL[WALL.length-1]!==11)
              throw Error('Wall contact hook layout changed.');
            const fn=join(WALL.subarray(0,WALL.length-1),old.subarray(a.end));
            pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else pieces.push(bytes.subarray(sizeAt,fnEnd));
          p.i=fnEnd;
        }
        if(changed!==5 || p.i!==end)throw Error('Native AI hooks were not found.');
        const section=join(...pieces);
        output=join(bytes.subarray(0,start),Uint8Array.of(10),leb(section.length),section,bytes.subarray(end));
        break;
      }
      p.i=end;
    }
    if(!output)throw Error('Native AI hook was not found.');
    return output;
  }
  function patchDragSelector(old,config) {
    const a=locals(old),off=config.offset;
    if(old.length!==config.originalLength || a.types.length!==4 || a.types.some(t=>t!==127) || old[off]!==65 || old[off+1]!==3)
      throw Error('Native drag selector layout changed.');
    // The exact module hash pins the site; preserve every other native instruction.
    return join(Uint8Array.of(1,config.locals,127),old.subarray(a.end,off),Uint8Array.from(config.expression),old.subarray(off+2));
  }
  function patchDragInputBody(old,config) {
    const a=locals(old),expected=config.originalTypes.map(t=>({i32:127,f32:125}[t]));
    if(old.length!==config.originalLength || a.types.length!==expected.length || a.types.some((t,i)=>t!==expected[i]))
      throw Error('Native drag input lifecycle layout changed.');
    return join(Uint8Array.from(config.header),Uint8Array.from(config.prefix),old.subarray(a.end));
  }
  function patchDragOverheatBody(old,config) {
    const a=locals(old),expected=config.originalTypes.map(t=>({i32:127,f32:125,f64:124}[t]));
    if(old.length!==config.originalLength || a.types.length!==expected.length || a.types.some((t,i)=>t!==expected[i]))throw Error('Native drag overheat layout changed.');
    return join(Uint8Array.from(config.header),Uint8Array.from(config.prefix),old.subarray(a.end));
  }
  function patchOwnedNosBody(old,config) {
    const a=locals(old),off=config.offset,expected=config.originalTypes.map(t=>({i32:127,f32:125,f64:124}[t]));
    if(old.length!==config.originalLength || a.types.length!==expected.length || a.types.some((t,i)=>t!==expected[i]) || old[off-3]!==65 || old[off-2]!==2 || old[off-1]!==71)
      throw Error('Native nitrous gate layout changed.');
    // Keep the original type2 comparison, then optionally accept the guarded owned player.
    return join(Uint8Array.from(config.header),old.subarray(a.end,off),Uint8Array.from(config.expression),old.subarray(off));
  }
  function patchDriftRecoveryBody(old,config) {
    const a=locals(old),off=config.offset,expected=config.originalTypes.map(t=>({i32:127,f32:125,f64:124}[t]));
    if(old.length!==config.originalLength || a.types.length!==expected.length || a.types.some((t,i)=>t!==expected[i]) || config.needle.some((v,i)=>old[off+i]!==v) || config.slice.some((v,i)=>old[config.sliceOffset+i]!==v))
      throw Error('Native drift recovery layout changed.');
    // The full-module hash pins the body. Only its player-curve expression
    // and appended authored locals change; no calls, stores or persistent undo.
    return join(Uint8Array.from(config.header),old.subarray(a.end,off),Uint8Array.from(config.expression),old.subarray(off+config.needle.length));
  }
  function patchCurrent(bytes,profile) {
    const bridge=Uint8Array.from(profile.bridge),p={i:8};
    while(p.i<bytes.length){
      const start=p.i,id=bytes[p.i++],size=read(bytes,p),begin=p.i,end=begin+size;
      if(end>bytes.length)throw Error('Invalid current module section');
      if(id===10){
        const n=read(bytes,p),pieces=[bytes.subarray(begin,p.i)];let changed=0;
        for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
          const at=p.i,len=read(bytes,p),body=p.i,stop=body+len;
          if(stop>end)throw Error('Invalid current function');
          const nos=profile.capabilities.ownedNativeNos && profile.ownedNos.find(c=>c.target===i);
          if(profile.capabilities.nativeDragOverheat && i===profile.dragOverheat.target){
            const fn=patchDragOverheatBody(bytes.subarray(body,stop),profile.dragOverheat);pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(profile.capabilities.nativeDriftRecovery && i===profile.driftRecovery.target){
            const fn=patchDriftRecoveryBody(bytes.subarray(body,stop),profile.driftRecovery);pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(nos){
            const fn=patchOwnedNosBody(bytes.subarray(body,stop),nos);pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(profile.capabilities.nativeDragInputHandoff && i===profile.dragInputGuard.target){
            const fn=patchDragInputBody(bytes.subarray(body,stop),profile.dragInputGuard);pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(profile.capabilities.opponentDrag && i===profile.dragSelector.target){
            const fn=patchDragSelector(bytes.subarray(body,stop),profile.dragSelector);pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(i===profile.target){
            const old=bytes.subarray(body,stop),a=locals(old),b=locals(bridge);
            if(a.types.length!==31||b.types.length!==profile.locals||a.types.some((v,k)=>v!==b.types[k])||old[old.length-1]!==11||bridge[bridge.length-1]!==11)throw Error('Current AI hook layout changed.');
            const fn=join(bridge.subarray(0,bridge.length-1),old.subarray(a.end));pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(profile.capabilities.pace && i===profile.pace.target){
            const old=bytes.subarray(body,stop),replacement=Uint8Array.from(profile.pace.bridge);
            if(locals(old).types.length!==1||old[old.length-1]!==11||replacement[replacement.length-1]!==11)throw Error('Current pace hook layout changed.');
            pieces.push(leb(replacement.length),replacement);changed++;
          }else if(profile.capabilities.corner && i===BRAKING.index-37){
            const fn=patchBrakingBody(bytes.subarray(body,stop));pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(profile.capabilities.corner && i===CORNER.index-37){
            const fn=patchCornerBody(bytes.subarray(body,stop));pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(profile.capabilities.walls && i===profile.wall.target){
            const old=bytes.subarray(body,stop),replacement=Uint8Array.from(profile.wall.bridge),a=locals(old),b=locals(replacement);
            if(a.types.length!==1||a.types[0]!==127||b.types.length!==19||b.types[0]!==127||old[old.length-1]!==11||replacement[replacement.length-1]!==11)throw Error('Current wall hook layout changed.');
            const fn=join(replacement.subarray(0,replacement.length-1),old.subarray(a.end));pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else pieces.push(bytes.subarray(at,stop));
          p.i=stop;
        }
        if(changed!==1+Number(!!profile.capabilities.nativeDragOverheat)+Number(!!profile.capabilities.nativeDragInputHandoff)+Number(!!profile.capabilities.nativeDriftRecovery)+(profile.capabilities.ownedNativeNos?profile.ownedNos.length:0)+Number(!!profile.capabilities.opponentDrag)+Number(profile.capabilities.pace)+2*Number(profile.capabilities.corner)+Number(profile.capabilities.walls)||p.i!==end)throw Error('Current AI hook was not found.');
        const section=join(...pieces);return join(bytes.subarray(0,start),Uint8Array.of(10),leb(section.length),section,bytes.subarray(end));
      }
      p.i=end;
    }
    throw Error('Current code section was not found.');
  }
  function install() {
    if(installed || typeof WebAssembly.compileStreaming!=='function')return;
    installed=true;
    const nativeStreaming=WebAssembly.compileStreaming, nativeCompile=WebAssembly.compile;
    WebAssembly.compileStreaming=async function(source,options){
      const response=await source;
      let url;try{url=new URL(response.url);}catch{return nativeStreaming.call(WebAssembly,response,options);}
      if(url.origin!==location.origin || url.pathname!=='/game.wasm')return nativeStreaming.call(WebAssembly,response,options);
      const generation=++loadGeneration,state={phase:'preparing',reason:'Preparing native AI bridge.'};
      // Concurrent loads keep independent facts; only the newest observed load publishes diagnostics.
      const publish=()=>{if(generation!==loadGeneration)return;for(const key of Object.keys(patchState))delete patchState[key];Object.assign(patchState,state);};
      publish();
      let stage='module-read';
      try{
        const bytes=await response.clone().arrayBuffer();
        state.moduleBytes=bytes.byteLength;
        const candidate=profileForSize(bytes.byteLength);
        if(candidate)state.candidateRevision=candidate.revision;
        // Read-only fingerprint coverage. It never grants compatibility or changes hooks.
        const scanner=root.__NFSU2_SIGNATURES__,references=[root.__NFSU2_SIGNATURE_PROFILE__,root.__NFSU2_SIGNATURE_PROFILE_LATEST__,root.__NFSU2_SIGNATURE_PROFILE_NEXT__].filter(Boolean);
        if(scanner?.scanAll&&references.length)try{
          const result=await scanner.scanAll(bytes,references),summary=result.bestReference;
          state.moduleHash=summary.moduleSha256;
          Object.assign(state,{signatureReference:summary.referenceRevision,signatureExact:summary.referenceModuleMatches,signatureTotal:summary.anchors,signatureUnique:summary.unique,signatureAmbiguous:summary.ambiguous,signatureMissing:summary.missing});
        }catch{state.signatureFailed=true;}
        stage='module-layout';
        let changed=await patchBytes(bytes);
        let captureInstalled=false;
        const capture=root.__NFSU2_RACE_CAPTURE__,captureProfile=profileForSize(bytes.byteLength);
        if(capture&&captureProfile?.hash===capture.PIN){
          try{const candidateBytes=await capture.patchModule(changed,captureProfile);if(!WebAssembly.validate(candidateBytes))throw Error('Capture module validation failed');changed=candidateBytes;captureInstalled=true;}
          catch{state.captureUnavailable=true;}
        }
        stage='module-compile';
        const profile=profileForSize(bytes.byteLength),forward=root.__NFSU2_FORWARD_NATIVE_PATCHER__;
        let module,forwardInstalled=false,routeChoiceInstalled=false,rubberbandInstalled=false,nativeCornerInstalled=false,pacedCatchupInstalled=false;
        const rubberband=root.__NFSU2_NATIVE_RUBBERBAND__;
        const compileCandidate=async input=>{
          try{
            if(rubberband?.supports?.(profile.hash)===true){
              const assisted=await rubberband.patchModule(Uint8Array.from(input),{verifiedOriginalHash:profile.hash});
              if(!WebAssembly.validate(assisted))throw Error('Catch-up module validation failed.');
              try{
                const cornerTarget=root.__NFSU2_NATIVE_CORNER_TARGET__;
                if(cornerTarget?.supports?.(profile.hash)===true){
                  const cornerBytes=await cornerTarget.patchModule(Uint8Array.from(assisted),{verifiedOriginalHash:profile.hash});
                  if(!WebAssembly.validate(cornerBytes))throw Error('Corner target module validation failed.');
                  try{
                    const paced=root.__NFSU2_PACED_CATCHUP__;
                    if(paced?.supports?.(profile.hash)===true){
                      const pacedBytes=await paced.patchModule(Uint8Array.from(cornerBytes),{verifiedOriginalHash:profile.hash});
                      if(!WebAssembly.validate(pacedBytes))throw Error('Paced catch-up module validation failed.');
                      const compiled=await nativeCompile.call(WebAssembly,pacedBytes,options);
                      rubberbandInstalled=true;nativeCornerInstalled=true;pacedCatchupInstalled=true;return compiled;
                    }
                  }catch{state.pacedCatchupUnavailable=true;}
                  const compiled=await nativeCompile.call(WebAssembly,cornerBytes,options);
                  rubberbandInstalled=true;nativeCornerInstalled=true;return compiled;
                }
              }catch{state.nativeCornerUnavailable=true;}
              const compiled=await nativeCompile.call(WebAssembly,assisted,options);
              rubberbandInstalled=true;return compiled;
            }
          }catch{state.rubberbandUnavailable=true;}
          return nativeCompile.call(WebAssembly,input,options);
        };
        const forwardSupported=forward?.supports?.(profile.hash)===true;
        if(forwardSupported){
          try{
            const candidateBytes=await forward.patchModule(Uint8Array.from(changed),{verifiedOriginalHash:profile.hash});
            if(!WebAssembly.validate(candidateBytes))throw Error('Forward native module validation failed.');
            const shortcut=root.__NFSU2_SHORTCUT_POLICY__;
            if(shortcut?.supports?.(profile.hash)===true||shortcut?.sourceModuleHash===profile.hash){
              try{
                const routeInput=Uint8Array.from(candidateBytes);
                const routeBytes=await shortcut.patchModule(routeInput,{verifiedOriginalHash:profile.hash});
                module=await compileCandidate(routeBytes);
                routeChoiceInstalled=routeBytes!==routeInput;
              }catch{state.routeChoiceUnavailable=true;}
            }
            // Retain the already verified forward adapter on optional failure.
            if(!module)module=await compileCandidate(candidateBytes);
            forwardInstalled=true;
          }catch(e){state.forwardUnavailable=true;state.forwardReason=String(e?.message||'Forward native adapter could not be prepared.');}
        }
        if(!module)module=await nativeCompile.call(WebAssembly,changed,options);
        const capabilities={...profile.capabilities};
        capabilities.nativeRubberband=rubberbandInstalled;state.nativeRubberband=rubberbandInstalled;
        capabilities.nativeCornerTarget=nativeCornerInstalled;state.nativeCornerTarget=nativeCornerInstalled;
        capabilities.nativePacedCatchup=pacedCatchupInstalled;state.nativePacedCatchup=pacedCatchupInstalled;
        if(captureInstalled)capabilities.nativeRaceCapture=true;
        if(routeChoiceInstalled){capabilities.nativeRouteChoice=true;state.nativeRouteChoice=true;}
        if(profile.capabilities.nativePaceTargetConsumers){
          capabilities.nativePaceTargetConsumers=forwardInstalled;
          capabilities.pace=forwardInstalled;
        }
        if(forwardSupported){
          capabilities.nativeForwardGeometry=forwardInstalled;capabilities.nativeForwardClamp=forwardInstalled;
          state.nativeForwardGeometry=forwardInstalled;state.nativeForwardClamp=forwardInstalled;
        }
        patched.set(module,captureInstalled||forwardSupported?Object.freeze({...profile,capabilities:Object.freeze(capabilities)}):profile);
        if(profile.capabilities.fullTuner&&root.__NFSU2_DYNO_NATIVE__){const prepared=root.__NFSU2_DYNO_NATIVE__.build(bytes);prepared.catch(()=>{});nativeEvaluators.set(module,prepared);}
        state.phase='ready';state.revision=profile.revision;state.reason='Verified game module · native AI bridge loaded.';
        publish();return module;
      }catch(e){
        state.phase='unavailable';state.reason=String(e?.message || 'Native AI could not be prepared.');
        state.patchCode=['module-size','module-hash'].includes(e?.patchCode)?e.patchCode:stage;
        if(typeof e?.moduleHash==='string'&&/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(e.moduleHash))state.moduleHash=e.moduleHash;
        // Fail open to the unchanged game, closed to AI control. All memory-writing tools still require a verified module profile.
        publish();return nativeStreaming.call(WebAssembly,response,options);
      }
    };
  }
  class Controller {
    constructor(memory,available=false,capabilities=LEGACY.capabilities,{moduleHash=null}={}){this.memory=memory;this.available=!!available;this.capabilities=capabilities;this.forwardRuntime=FORWARD_CONFIG?.select?.(moduleHash)?.runtime||null;this.hb=0;this.words=null;this.view=null;this.requestTarget=null;this.handbackPending=false;this.handbackHeartbeat=0;this.forwardNetworkKey=null;}
    refresh(){const b=this.memory.buffer;if(!this.view || this.view.buffer!==b){this.view=new DataView(b);this.words=new Int32Array(b);}return b.byteLength>=(this.capabilities.corner?CORNER.commandBase+64:BASE+92);}
    u32(p){return p>=0x10000 && p+4<=Math.min(this.view.byteLength,0x28000000)?this.view.getUint32(p,true):0;}
    read(off){return Atomics.load(this.words,(BASE+off)/4)>>>0;}
    write(off,v){Atomics.store(this.words,(BASE+off)/4,v|0);}
    forwardContext(allowNetwork){
      const addresses=this.forwardRuntime?.onlineAddresses;
      if(!addresses)return null;
      const nativeContext=addresses.map((p,i)=>p+(i===1?1:4)<=this.view.byteLength?(i===1?this.view.getUint8(p):this.view.getUint32(p,true)):null);
      if(nativeContext.includes(null))return null;
      const tuple=[this.u32(0x850078),this.u32(0x866a14),this.u32(0x8669f4),this.view.getUint8(0x89cf69),this.u32(0x850088)];
      return {key:JSON.stringify([...tuple,...nativeContext,allowNetwork===true]),network:!!((tuple[0]&520)||tuple[1]||tuple[2]||tuple[3]||(nativeContext[0]&&nativeContext[1]&&nativeContext[2]))};
    }
    cornerSettings(mode,pace,cornerAssist,cornerFactor,cornerMargin,raceCornerAssist,raceCornerFactor,raceCornerMargin,raceBraking,allowNetwork=false,adaptiveCorners=false){
      const raceType=this.u32(0x89e7b0),drag=!!this.view.getUint8(0x89e7d8);
      const special=drag||this.view.getUint8(0x89e7d9)||this.u32(0x890104)||this.u32(0x890108)||this.u32(0x890114);
      const network=(this.u32(0x850078)&520)||this.u32(0x866a14)||this.u32(0x8669f4)||this.view.getUint8(0x89cf69);
      const streetX=this.view.getUint8(0x89e7e3)||this.u32(0x89010c)||network&&this.u32(0x850088)===10;
      const command=!this.capabilities.corner?0:raceCornerAssist===true&&mode===1&&raceType===1&&!special&&(!network||allowNetwork===true)?adaptiveCorners===true&&this.capabilities.nativeDragInputHandoff===true&&!streetX&&Number.isFinite(pace)&&pace>=1&&pace<=2?3:2:cornerAssist===true&&mode===2&&raceType===0&&!drag?1:0;
      const factor=command>=2?raceCornerFactor:cornerFactor,sharp=command>=2?raceCornerMargin:cornerMargin;
      const percent=Number.isFinite(factor)&&factor>=.6&&factor<=.95?Math.round(factor*100):80;
      const margin=Number.isFinite(sharp)&&sharp>=0&&sharp<=25?Math.round(sharp):command>=2?15:0;
      const braking=command>=2?(Number.isFinite(raceBraking)&&raceBraking>=.5&&raceBraking<=1?Math.round(raceBraking*100):75):100;
      const pacePercent=command>=1&&this.capabilities.pace&&Number.isFinite(pace)&&pace>=.75&&pace<=3?Math.round((command===1?Math.max(1,pace):pace)*100):100;
      return {command,percent,margin,braking,pacePercent};
    }
    nativeDriftPace() {
      return this.capabilities.nativeDriftPace===true && !this.view.getUint8(0x89e7d8) && !this.u32(0x890108) && !!(this.view.getUint8(0x89e7d9)||this.u32(0x890104)||this.u32(0x890114));
    }
    publish(wanted=0,player=0,car=0,race=0,pace=1,allowNetwork=false,allowDragAI=false,cornerAssist=false,cornerFactor=0.8,cornerMargin=0,raceCornerAssist=false,raceCornerFactor=.8,raceCornerMargin=15,raceBraking=.75,dragNoBlowout=false,adaptiveCorners=false,adaptivePace=null){
      if(!this.available || !this.refresh() || this.read(28)!==MAGIC)return false;
      pace=this.capabilities.pace&&!this.nativeDriftPace()?pace:1;allowDragAI=this.capabilities.dragAI&&allowDragAI;cornerAssist=this.capabilities.corner&&cornerAssist;
      // OFF is a command the native loop must process, not merely a page
      // state. A quick same-event restart must not overwrite an unseen OFF.
      if(wanted===0 && this.read(8)!==0)this.handbackPending=true;
      // A geometry response is bound to this command generation. For the
      // separately installed exact-build forward sampler, identical adaptive
      // commands need a new heartbeat without inventing a new generation.
      // Changed settings and every OFF still use the full sequence protocol.
      const forwardContext=this.capabilities.nativeForwardGeometry===true?this.forwardContext(allowNetwork):null;
      if(forwardContext&&wanted===1&&adaptiveCorners===true&&!this.handbackPending&&(!forwardContext.network||allowNetwork===true)&&this.forwardNetworkKey===forwardContext.key){
        const settings=this.cornerSettings(wanted,pace,cornerAssist,cornerFactor,cornerMargin,raceCornerAssist,raceCornerFactor,raceCornerMargin,raceBraking,allowNetwork,adaptiveCorners);
        const live=settings.command===3&&Number.isFinite(adaptivePace)&&adaptivePace>=.75&&adaptivePace<=pace?adaptivePace:pace;

  function sanitize(value) {

      else if(d.aiDriverVerified)driver='Native AI · not tool-owned';
      else driver='Driver unavailable';
    }
    const adaptiveRequested=d.adaptiveRaceRequested===true;
    const cityRequested=c.cityPacing===true&&c.roam&&d.network===true&&choices.online===true&&aiSelected&&d.aiActive===true&&d.aiOwned===true;
    const selected=cityRequested||adaptiveRequested|| (c.roam?choices.aiPace:c.race?choices.racePace:false);
    const factor=cityRequested?c.cityPace:adaptiveRequested?d.adaptiveRaceCeiling:c.roam?choices.paceFactor:c.race?choices.racePaceFactor:1;
    let pace=blocked?'Not confirmed':c.paceAvailable===false?'Unavailable on this build':c.drag||c.drift?'Native · custom pace paused':!c.roam&&!c.race?'Unavailable in this mode':!selected?'Native target':Number.isFinite(factor)?factor.toFixed(2)+'× selected':'Unavailable';
    if(live&&!blocked&&c.paceAvailable!==false&&!c.drag&&!c.drift&&(c.roam||c.race)) {
      const target=selected?factor:1;
      if(aiSelected&&Number.isFinite(target)) {
        // An older acknowledgement must not confirm a newly selected factor.
        const confirmed=d.paceConfirmed===true && !c.switching && Number.isFinite(d.paceApplied) && d.paceApplied>=.75 && d.paceApplied<=3 && Math.abs(d.paceApplied-target)<.011;
        pace=target.toFixed(2)+'× req · '+(confirmed?d.paceApplied.toFixed(2)+'× ack':'pending');
      } else if(selected&&Number.isFinite(factor))pace=factor.toFixed(2)+'× selected · AI off';
    }
    if(cityRequested&&!blocked)pace='City '+pace;
    if(adaptiveRequested&&!blocked&&Number.isFinite(factor)){
      const requested=Number.isFinite(d.adaptiveRuntimePace)?d.adaptiveRuntimePace.toFixed(2)+'× req':'pending';
      const reason=d.adaptivePacingState==='native-fallback'?'native pace · corner coverage unknown':d.adaptivePacingState==='coverage-unknown'?'route coverage unknown':d.adaptivePacingState==='clearance-limited'?'clearance slowing':d.adaptiveRaceState==='planner-observed'?'planner observed':'pending';
      pace=`Adaptive ${factor.toFixed(2)}× ceiling · ${requested} · ${reason}`;
    }
    const req=choices.boost?choices.power:1;
    const requested=Number.isFinite(req)?req.toFixed(1)+'× req':'Requested';
    const states={'network-permission':'online paused',unsupported:'unavailable','not-ready':'waiting',hidden:'paused',unfocused:'paused',hud:'waiting','not-driving':'waiting',menu:'paused','drift-change':'waiting',layout:'unavailable',settling:'settling',suspended:'paused','tuner-busy':'tuner busy',neutral:'neutral',changed:'changed',rejected:'rejected'};
    let power=!(choices.boost||choices.unlimit)?'Off':requested+' · '+(blocked?'not confirmed':states[d.powerStatus]||'pending');
    if(!blocked&&d.powerStatus==='applied'&&d.powerActive===true&&Number.isFinite(d.effectivePower)&&d.effectivePower>=1&&d.effectivePower<=3&&Math.abs(d.effectivePower-req)<.011)power=requested+' · '+d.effectivePower.toFixed(1)+'× set';
    const limiter=!choices.unlimit?'':!blocked&&d.powerStatus==='applied'&&d.limiterRemoved===true?' · governor removed':' · governor requested';
    return {governor:limiter?limiter.slice(3):'',speed,unit:speed==='Unavailable'?'':'km/h',context,driver,pace,power,powerTitle:power+limiter+'. Set reports guarded power-field writes, not measured speed or horsepower.',state:paused||(d.network&&!choices.online?'Read-only · network tools paused':'Live observations'),speedTitle:speed==='Unavailable'?(paused||'Speed telemetry is unavailable for this build or car.'):'Native speed sample converted from m/s to km/h. Not a GPS or measured tuning gain.'};
  }
  function renderInfoHud() {

    }
  }

  function clearApplicationEvidence(status='suspended') {
    stopRubberband();
    // Reporting only. Actual restoration and native handback remain owned by
    // the existing callers, and are not claimed to have completed here.
    try {
      pauseRaceStats();
      clearPaceEvidence();
      const powerStatus=prefs.boost||prefs.unlimit?status:'off';
      diagnosticState={...diagnosticState,powerStatus,powerActive:false,effectivePower:undefined,limiterRemoved:false};
      renderPowerStatus(powerStatus);
    } catch {}
  }
  function pendingCornerText(state) {
    // Existing read-only evidence only. Stages are the furthest native check
    // reached for this request, not a diagnosis of the latest turn or failure.
    // A missing hit does not prove the road has no qualifying bends.
    if (state.cornerHits > 0) return 'Armed · waiting for current settings confirmation';
    if (state.cornerRouteOwned === true && state.cornerPlannerCorners === 0) return 'Armed · native plan currently has no corner entries';
    if (state.cornerProbeStage === 6) return 'Armed · limiting curve seen; reduction not confirmed';
    if (state.cornerProbeStage === 5) return 'Armed · planner reached; no speed reduction recorded';
    if (state.cornerProbeStage >= 1 && state.cornerProbeStage <= 4) return 'Armed · native corner checks not yet complete';
    return 'Armed · no native corner reduction recorded';
  }
  function cornerEvidenceText(state) {
    const count = value => Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 0 && value <= 40 ? value : 'unknown';
    const stage = Number.isInteger(state.cornerProbeStage) && state.cornerProbeStage >= 0 && state.cornerProbeStage <= 7 ? state.cornerProbeStage : 'unknown';
    const mask = Number.isInteger(state.cornerGuardMask) && state.cornerGuardMask >= 0 && state.cornerGuardMask <= 255 ? state.cornerGuardMask : null;
    const checks = [[1,'command/profile'],[2,'AI ownership'],[4,'game context'],[8,'race state'],[16,'drag/drift exclusion'],[32,'network permission'],[64,'driver identity'],[128,'private route']];
    const sampled = mask === null ? 'unknown' : mask ? checks.filter(([bit]) => mask & bit).map(([,name]) => name).join(', ') : 'none';
    return `Native route points: ${count(state.cornerRouteNodes)}; corner entries: ${count(state.cornerPlannerCorners)}; usable sampled bends: ${count(state.cornerPlannerUsable)}. Furthest native check: ${stage}/7; 7 means a hit exists. Sampled unmet checks: ${sampled}. Counts/checks are snapshots, not a proven cause. Export a short crash log after several turns if no reduction is recorded.`;
  }
  const NativeWorker = window.Worker;
  // Observe only the known game worker; AI validates its patched module separately.
  window.Worker = new Proxy(NativeWorker, {
    construct(Target, args, NewTarget) {
      const worker = Reflect.construct(Target, args, NewTarget);
      let url; try { url = new URL(String(args[0]), location.href); } catch { return worker; }
      if (url.origin !== location.origin || url.pathname !== '/host/game-worker.js') return worker;
      const send = worker.postMessage;
      let bootSession=null;
      worker.postMessage = function (m, ...rest) {
        if (m && m.mod instanceof WebAssembly.Module && m.memory instanceof WebAssembly.Memory && Number.isSafeInteger(m.slot) && m.slot>=0) {
          if(m.slot===0){
          const verifiedProfile=AI?.getModuleProfile?.(m.mod)||null;
          if (!engine || engine.memory !== m.memory || activeModule!==m.mod || activeWorker!==worker || moduleProfile!==verifiedProfile) {
            // Release only the previous verified session before sending the new
            // module to its worker. A reused memory object is not an identity.
            cameraDirector?.reset();clearCameraPulse();
            if(engine&&moduleProfile){try{const state=engine.state();engine.restorePerformance(state);engine.restoreGrip(state);}catch{}}
            forwardDrive?.invalidate();forwardDrive=null;
            dyno?.cancel();wall?.stop();cars?.stop();ai?.stop();
            sessionGeneration++;activeWorker=worker;activeModule=m.mod;moduleProfile=verifiedProfile;refreshCompatibility();
            // A new module/worker/memory generation has no current native
            // observations yet. Do not carry prior application or ownership
            // evidence into its boot event or an immediate diagnostic export.
            diagnosticState={generation:sessionGeneration,revision:moduleProfile?.revision||'unknown',supported,ready:false,driving:false,safe:false,tools:diagnosticTools()};
            clearApplicationEvidence('not-ready');
            diagnosticIdentity=null;
            recordDiagnostic('game-boot',{generation:sessionGeneration,slot:m.slot,memoryMiB:m.memory.buffer.byteLength/1048576,revision:moduleProfile?.revision||'unknown',supported,tools:diagnosticTools()});
            const caps=moduleProfile?.capabilities;
            forwardDrive=caps?.nativeForwardGeometry&&caps?.nativeForwardClamp&&globalThis.__NFSU2_FORWARD_DRIVING__?.Controller?new globalThis.__NFSU2_FORWARD_DRIVING__.Controller(m.memory,{verified:true,installed:true,moduleHash:moduleProfile.hash,moduleIdentity:m.mod}):null;
            rubberband=caps?.nativePacedCatchup&&globalThis.__NFSU2_PACED_CATCHUP_CONTROLLER__?.Controller?new globalThis.__NFSU2_PACED_CATCHUP_CONTROLLER__.Controller(m.memory,{installed:true,verified:true,moduleHash:moduleProfile.hash,moduleIdentity:m.mod}):null;
            nativeCalculatedState={eligible:false,reason:'unsafe'};
            rubberbandSnapshot=rubberband?.status(performance.now())||{state:'unsupported',active:false,resetPending:false};
            diagnosticState={...diagnosticState,...rubberbandEvidence()};renderRubberband();
            renderForwardStatus();
            raceCapture?.invalidate('Game session changed');
            raceCapture=caps?.nativeRaceCapture&&globalThis.__NFSU2_RACE_CAPTURE__?.Controller?new globalThis.__NFSU2_RACE_CAPTURE__.Controller(m.memory,true,m.mod):null;updateRaceCapture();
            dyno=caps?.fullTuner && globalThis.__NFSU2_DYNO_FULL__?.Controller?new globalThis.__NFSU2_DYNO_FULL__.Controller(m.memory,true,moduleProfile.revision,{prepared:AI.getNativeEvaluator(m.mod),module:m.mod}):caps?.dyno && globalThis.__NFSU2_DYNO__?.Controller?new globalThis.__NFSU2_DYNO__.Controller(m.memory,true,moduleProfile.revision):null;dyno?.setEnabled(dynoEnabled);
            wall=caps?.walls && Walls?.Controller?new Walls.Controller(m.memory,true,moduleProfile.wall):null;
            cars=caps?.cars && Cars?.Controller?new Cars.Controller(m.memory,true,moduleProfile.cars):null;
            ai=AI?.Controller?new AI.Controller(m.memory,!!caps?.ai,caps,{moduleHash:moduleProfile?.hash}):null;
            engine = new Engine(m.memory,moduleProfile?.statusCapacity,moduleProfile?.hash); statusPtr = 0; inputPtr = 0; driftPending = null; driftNeedsReapply=typeof prefs.drift==='boolean'; powerGate.reset(); gripGate.reset();
          }
          }
          bootSession={module:m.mod,memory:m.memory,generation:activeModule===m.mod&&engine?.memory===m.memory?sessionGeneration:-1};
        }
        return Reflect.apply(send, this, [m, ...rest]);
      };
      const currentSession = () => !!bootSession && bootSession.generation===sessionGeneration && bootSession.module===activeModule && bootSession.memory===engine?.memory;
      worker.addEventListener('error', event => {
        if(currentSession())setCameraRotation(false);
        recordDiagnostic('worker-error',{sessionCurrent:currentSession(),error:event.error || event.message,tools:diagnosticTools()});
      });
      worker.addEventListener('message', event => {
        const m = event.data;
        if(m?.t==='trap')recordDiagnostic('game-trap',{sessionCurrent:currentSession(),tid:m.tid,error:m.msg,stack:m.stack,tools:diagnosticTools()});
        if(m?.t==='exit')recordDiagnostic('game-exit',{sessionCurrent:currentSession(),code:m.code,tools:diagnosticTools()});
        if(!currentSession())return;
        if(m?.t==='register' && (m.kind===3||m.kind===5))recordDiagnostic('game-register',{kind:m.kind});
        if (worker===activeWorker && m?.t === 'register' && m.kind === 3 && Number.isSafeInteger(m.ptr)) inputPtr = m.ptr;
        if (worker===activeWorker && m?.t === 'register' && m.kind === 5 && Number.isSafeInteger(m.ptr)) statusPtr = m.ptr;
        if (m?.t === 'exit' || m?.t === 'trap') {forwardDrive?.invalidate();forwardDrive=null;raceCapture?.invalidate('Recording stopped · game ended');updateRaceCapture();suspend('Game stopped. Enabled choices are kept for the next game.');ai=null;wall=null;cars=null;dyno=null;engine=null;activeWorker=null;activeModule=null;moduleProfile=null;refreshCompatibility();statusPtr=0;inputPtr=0;renderForwardStatus();}
      });
      return worker;
    }
  });
  // A different game revision must be reviewed before writing its memory.
  fetch('/game.json', { cache: 'no-store', credentials: 'omit' }).then(r => {
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error('Build information unavailable');

  function key(code, down) {
    const keyName = { ArrowUp: 'ArrowUp', ShiftLeft: 'Shift', AltLeft: 'Alt', KeyC: 'c' }[code] || code;
    window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(down ? 'keydown' : 'keyup', { code, key: keyName,
      location: /Left$/.test(code) ? 1 : 0, bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
  }
  function hold(code, down) {
    if (down && !held.has(code)) { if (!physicallyHeld.has(code)) { held.add(code); key(code, true); } }
    else if (!down && held.delete(code) && !physicallyHeld.has(code)) key(code, false);
  }

  }

  function suspend(why) {
    cameraDirector?.reset();
    stopRubberband();

    dyno?.cancel();
    wall?.stop();cars?.stop(); ai?.stop(); release(); powerGate.reset(); gripGate.reset();
    try {if(engine){const state=engine.state();engine.restorePerformance(state);engine.restoreGrip(state);}} catch { /* no stale pointer writes */ }
    clearApplicationEvidence();
    if(why) message(why);
  }

  function raceOnlyRaceContext() {

  }
  function takeControl() {

  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (!e.isTrusted) return;
    if(e.code==='Insert' && e.shiftKey && !e.ctrlKey && !e.altKey && !e.metaKey){
      // Shift+Insert remains Paste in text/editable controls, including controls
      // inside a shadow root. Otherwise it toggles all extension chrome.
      const path=e.composedPath?.()||[e.target];
      const editingNode=node=>{
        for(let depth=0;node&&depth<32;depth++,node=node.parentElement){
          if(node.isContentEditable || node.getAttribute?.('role')==='textbox' || /^(TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(node.tagName) || (node.tagName==='INPUT' && !/^(button|checkbox|radio|range|submit|reset|color|file|image|hidden)$/.test(String(node.type||'').toLowerCase())))return true;
        }
        return false;
      };
      // Window's composedPath hides our closed shadow tree. Its retained
      // activeElement is required to preserve Paste in the profile-name field.
      const editing=[...path,ui?.activeElement,document.activeElement].some(editingNode);
      if(e.isComposing || e.defaultPrevented || editing)return;
      e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat)setCleanView(!cleanView);return;
    }
    // Range controls keep their native arrow/Space behavior without taking over the car.
    if(host && e.composedPath?.().includes(host) && !['F6','F7','F8','F9','Escape'].includes(e.code)) return;
    if(e.code==='F6'){e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat)setInfoHud(!infoHudEnabled);return;}
    physicallyHeld.add(e.code);
    if(e.code==='KeyC'){cameraDirector?.reset();clearCameraPulse();}
    if(e.code==='F7') {e.preventDefault();takeControl();}
    else if((prefs.ai || (raceOnlyAI && raceOnlyRaceContext())) && ['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','KeyW','KeyA','KeyS','KeyD','Space'].includes(e.code)) takeControl();
    if (e.code === 'F8') { e.preventDefault();if(cleanView){setCleanView(false);setPanel(true);}else setPanel(!visible); }
    if (e.code === 'Escape') {if(hubOpen)setRaceHub(false);if(visible)setPanel(false);}
    if (e.code === 'F9') { e.preventDefault(); stop(); }
  }, true);
  window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.isTrusted) physicallyHeld.delete(e.code); }, true);

  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { recordDiagnostic(document.hidden?'pause':'resume',{reason:'hidden',hidden:document.hidden,tools:diagnosticTools()}); if (document.hidden) suspend('Paused while the tab is hidden. Your enabled choices are kept.'); });
  window.addEventListener('storage',event=>{
    if(!ToolProfiles||![null,ToolProfiles.KEY,ToolProfiles.STOP_KEY].includes(event.key))return;
    const after=profileStore.refresh();
    const changed=loadedProfile&&!after.data.profiles.some(p=>p.id===loadedProfile.id&&p.revision===loadedProfile.revision);
    if(event.key===null||event.key===ToolProfiles.STOP_KEY||!after.available||changed){
      stop('Profile storage or Stop changed in another tab. Current driving controls are off. Load a profile explicitly to resume.',false);
      profileSessionStopped=true;try{sessionStorage.setItem(PROFILE_SESSION_STOP,'1');}catch{}
    }
    profileSelection=null;profileNotice=after.error||'Profiles updated in another tab. Select a profile again; nothing was automatically loaded.';renderProfiles();
  });
  window.addEventListener('pageshow',event=>{
    if(!event.persisted)return;
    // A BFCache page must recheck durable Stop and profile permissions before it
    // resumes. Do not auto-reload a profile or revive a retained controller.
    stop('Page restored. Driving controls remain off; load a profile explicitly to resume.',false);
    profileStore?.refresh();profileSelection=null;profileNotice='Page restored with controls off. Select and Load a profile to resume.';renderProfiles();
    clearInterval(timer);timer=setInterval(tick,50);
  });
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => { recordDiagnostic('page-hide',{reason:'page-hide',tools:diagnosticTools()});savePrefs(); suspend(); clearInterval(timer); });

  function setDrift(wanted) {
    if (driftPending) return false;
    const state = engine?.state(), counters = engine && statusPtr ? engine.status(statusPtr) : null;
    if (!supported || !state?.ready || !state.driving || state.network || !counters || (counters.drive & 3) !== 2 || !Number.isFinite(counters.drift) || document.hidden || document.querySelector('dialog[open]')) {
      message('Drift assist only works while driving solo free roam with the game menus closed.'); return false;
    }
    if (!!(counters.drift & 1) === wanted) return true;
    // Rebuilding the native drift setup must not inherit our power multiplier.
    engine.restorePerformance(state);engine.restoreGrip(state);powerGate.reset();gripGate.reset();
    if (!engine.driftTap(inputPtr)) { message('Drift request not sent: the game input mailbox is unavailable, inactive, typing, or full.'); return false; }
    driftPending = { wanted, until: performance.now() + 3000 };
    ui.querySelector('#drift').disabled = true;
    message('Drift request sent. Waiting for the game to confirm its handling state…');
    return true;
  }
  function moduleFailure() {
    const patch=AI?.patchState;
    if(moduleProfile || patch?.phase!=='unavailable')return '';
    const reported=/^[a-f0-9]{8,40}$/.test(revision)?` Site reports build ${revision}.`:'';
    const bytes=Number.isSafeInteger(patch.moduleBytes)?` Loaded module: ${patch.moduleBytes} bytes.`:'';
    const signatures=Number.isInteger(patch.signatureUnique)?` Fingerprints: ${patch.signatureUnique}/${patch.signatureTotal} unique matches; this does not approve an unknown build.`:'';
    return ['module-size','module-hash'].includes(patch.patchCode)
      ? `Game module is not verified.${reported}${bytes} A compatible Driving Tools update is required.${signatures}`
      : `Game module could not be prepared.${reported} Reload once. If it persists, export the diagnostic log.`;
  }

  function setPanel(open) {

  function updateDynoUI() {
    if(!ui)return;
    const busy=!!dyno?.busy,ready=!!(dynoEnabled && supported && dyno?.canUse() && !document.hidden && document.hasFocus());
    const context=ready&&!busy?dyno?.syncContext?.():null;
    if(context?.invalidated)dynoText='Car tuning or installed parts changed. Load settings or find a new tune for this game mode.';
    else if(context?.changed)dynoText=dyno.applied?'Applied tune found for this car and mode. Restore is available while it stays unchanged.':dyno.outcome?'Preview found for this car and mode. Review it before Apply.':'Ready for the selected mode. Load all settings or search a measured native estimate.';
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-mode').textContent=context?`Game tuning slot ${context.kind+1} of 5${Tune?.MODE_LABELS?.[context.kind]?' · '+Tune.MODE_LABELS[context.kind]:''} · selected in Mode Select`:busy&&dyno?.context?`Game tuning slot ${dyno.context.kind+1} of 5`:'Choose a race mode in the game, then open the Dyno main screen.';
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-find').disabled=!ready || busy || !!dyno?.applied;
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-cancel').disabled=!busy;
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-apply').disabled=!ready || busy || !(dyno?.full?dyno.outcome?.changed:dyno?.outcome?.improved) || !!dyno?.applied;
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-restore').disabled=!ready || busy || !dyno?.applied;
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').disabled=busy;
    for(const option of ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').options||[])if(['acceleration60','acceleration100','topSpeed'].includes(option.value))option.disabled=!dyno?.full;
    if(dyno && !dyno.full&&['acceleration60','acceleration100','topSpeed'].includes(ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').value))ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').value='peakPower';
    updateSetupEditor(ready,busy);
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-state').textContent=moduleFailure()?`Dyno unavailable. ${moduleFailure()}`:moduleProfile&&!moduleProfile.capabilities.dyno?'Not yet verified for this build':dynoText;
  }
  const tuneValue=value=>(value>100?'+':'')+(value-100);
  function updateSetupEditor(ready,busy){
    const editor=dyno?.editor,editable=!!(ready&&!busy&&editor&&!dyno?.applied);
    ui.querySelector('#tune-load').disabled=!ready||busy||!!dyno?.applied||!dyno?.full;
    ui.querySelector('#tune-preview').disabled=!editable;
    ui.querySelector('#tune-reset').disabled=!editable;
    ui.querySelector('#tune-group').disabled=!editable;
    const group=Tune?.GROUPS?.find(g=>g.id===ui.querySelector('#tune-group').value)||Tune?.GROUPS?.[0];
    for(let i=0;i<9;i++){
      const offset=group?.offsets[i],present=!!editor&&offset!==undefined,row=ui.querySelector('#tune-row-'+i),input=ui.querySelector('#tune-input-'+i);
      row.hidden=!present;input.disabled=!editable||!editor?.allowedOffsets.includes(offset);
      if(present){
        input.dataset.offset=String(offset);input.value=editor.draft[offset]-100;
        ui.querySelector('#tune-label-'+i).textContent=(Tune?.FIELD_LABELS?.[offset]||'Setting '+(offset+1))+(editor.allowedOffsets.includes(offset)?'':editor.unlockedOffsets?.includes(offset)?' · unverified':' · locked');
        ui.querySelector('#tune-value-'+i).textContent=tuneValue(editor.draft[offset]);
      }
    }
    const o=dyno?.outcome;
    ui.querySelector('#tune-changes').textContent=dyno?.full&&Array.isArray(o?.changes)?o.changes.map(x=>`${Tune?.FIELD_LABELS?.[x.offset]||x.field}: ${tuneValue(x.before)} → ${tuneValue(x.after)}${x.adjusted?' (native adjusted request '+tuneValue(x.requested)+')':''}`).join('\n')||'No accepted setup changes.':editor?'Edit sliders, then Preview changes. Drafts never alter the game.':'Load settings to see unlocked controls for this car and preset.';
  }
  async function runDyno(action) {
    if(!dynoEnabled || !dyno || dyno.busy)return;
    recordDiagnostic('dyno-action',{reason:action,tools:diagnosticTools()});
    suspend();
    dyno.setEnabled(true);
    try {
      if(action==='load'){
        await dyno.loadSetup();dynoText='All supported settings loaded. Edit a category, then Preview. Nothing changes in the game until Stage.';
      } else if(action==='preview'){
        const r=await dyno.preview();
        dynoText=`${r.changed?'Preview ready. Review accepted changes, then Stage selected preset.':'No accepted setup changes.'} Game unchanged. Native estimates: 0–60 ${r.bestResult.zeroTo60Seconds.toFixed(2)} s; 0–100 ${r.bestResult.zeroTo100Seconds.toFixed(2)} s; top ${(r.bestResult.topSpeedMps*3.6).toFixed(1)} km/h; ${r.bestResult.peakPowerKw.toFixed(1)} kW / ${r.bestResult.peakTorqueNm.toFixed(1)} Nm. NOS ${r.bestResult.nitrousSeconds.toFixed(2)} s / torque setting ${r.bestResult.nitrousTorque.toFixed(3)}. No handling/lap-time measurement.`;
      } else if(action==='find') {
        dynoText=dyno.full?'Searching in private memory · game setup stays unchanged':'Searching · original setup is restored after each trial';updateDynoUI();
        const r=await dyno.find({goal:ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').value,onProgress:p=>{dynoText=`Searching ${p.evaluations}/${p.budget} trials · Cancel or F9 to stop`;updateDynoUI();}});
        const [field,unit]=({peakPower:['peakPowerKw','kW'],peakTorque:['peakTorqueNm','Nm'],acceleration60:['zeroTo60Seconds','s (0–60)'],acceleration100:['zeroTo100Seconds','s (0–100)'],topSpeed:['topSpeedMps','m/s']}[r.goal]);
        if(dyno.full){
          const manualSeed=r.seed?.some((value,index)=>value!==r.baseline[index]);
          const seedText=manualSeed&&r.changed?(r.improvedFromSeed?' Search improved the measured goal over your draft.':' No further measured improvement over the draft. Accepted manual draft retained.'):'';
          dynoText=`${r.baselineResult[field].toFixed(1)} → ${r.bestResult[field].toFixed(1)} ${unit} · ${r.evaluations} trials. Original kept. ${r.improved?'Measured goal improved versus original.':'No measured goal improvement versus original.'}${seedText} ${r.changed?'Review accepted changes, then Stage selected preset.':'No accepted setup changes.'} No handling/lap-time measurement.`;
        }else dynoText=`${r.baselineResult[field].toFixed(1)} → ${r.bestResult[field].toFixed(1)} ${unit} · ${r.evaluations} trials. Original kept. ${r.improved?'Stage preview to use this tune.':'No improvement found.'}`;
      } else if(action==='apply') {const r=await dyno.apply();dynoText=dyno.full?'Selected preset staged. Use the game’s Test Run to refresh driving physics, and Save Profile to persist. Disk save is not confirmed.'+(r.saveReady?'':' Other presets also have unsaved edits; native Save Profile saves them too.'):'Best tune applied. Use native Save Profile to persist.';}
      else {await dyno.restore();dynoText=dyno.full?'Previous current and selected-visit settings restored. Test Run refreshes physics. Save Profile again if you want this restored version persisted.':'Previous tune restored and confirmed.';}
    } catch(error) {recordDiagnostic('dyno-error',{error,dynoStatus:error?.dynoStatus,dynoGuard:error?.dynoGuard,dynoObserved:error?.dynoObserved,tools:diagnosticTools()});dynoText=error?.message || 'Dyno tuner stopped. Reload before retrying.';}
    updateDynoUI();
  }
  function exportDiagnostic() {
    if(!diagnostics){message('Diagnostic logger is unavailable. The game’s Download log may still have crash details.');return;}
    let url=null,link=null;
    try {
      recordDiagnostic('export',{tools:diagnosticTools()});
      const blob=new Blob([diagnostics.exportText()],{type:'application/json'});
      url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);link=document.createElement('a');link.href=url;link.download='nfsu2-driving-tools-diagnostics.json';link.hidden=true;
      (document.body||document.documentElement).append(link);link.click();
      message('Diagnostic download requested. It stays local until you choose to share the file. For native crash details, also use the game’s Download log.');
    } catch(error) {recordDiagnostic('engine-error',{error});message('Diagnostic download failed. Try again, or use the game’s Download log.');}
    finally {link?.remove();if(url)setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);}
  }
  const profileToggleIds={raceCornerAssist:'race-corner-assist',cornerAssist:'corner-assist',racePace:'race-pace',walls:'walls',cars:'cars',traffic:'traffic',players:'players',online:'online',ai:'ai',aiPace:'ai-pace',nos:'nos',dragNoBlowout:'drag-no-blowout',drag:'drag',tester:'tester',boost:'boost',unlimit:'unlimit',grip:'grip'};

  const profileLocks=()=>typeof navigator!=='undefined'&&navigator.locks&&typeof navigator.locks.request==='function'?navigator.locks:null;
  function renderProfiles(){
    if(!ui)return;
    const state=profileStore?.snapshot(),select=ui.querySelector('#profile-select');
    select.replaceChildren();const empty=document.createElement('option');empty.value='';empty.textContent='Choose a saved profile';select.append(empty);
    for(const p of state?.data.profiles||[]){const option=document.createElement('option');option.value=p.id;option.textContent=p.name;select.append(option);}
    const selected=state?.data.profiles.find(p=>p.id===profileSelection?.id&&p.revision===profileSelection?.revision);
    if(!selected){profileSelection=null;ui.querySelector('#profile-network').checked=false;}
    select.value=selected?.id||'';
    for(const id of ['profile-load','profile-update','profile-delete','profile-auto'])ui.querySelector('#'+id).disabled=profileActionPending||!state?.available||!selected||(id!=='profile-load'&&!profileLocks());
    ui.querySelector('#profile-save').disabled=profileActionPending||!state?.available||!profileLocks();
    for(const id of ['profile-select','profile-name','profile-network'])ui.querySelector('#'+id).disabled=profileActionPending;
    ui.querySelector('#profile-auto').checked=!!selected&&state.data.auto?.id===selected.id&&state.data.auto.stopToken===state.stopToken&&!profileSessionStopped;
    ui.querySelector('#profile-state').textContent=state?.error||(profileActionPending?'Waiting for another tab to finish saving profiles.':profileNotice)||(!profileLocks()?'Profile editing is unavailable because this browser cannot lock local saves.':!profileStore?'Profiles unavailable; existing controls still work.':state.paused?'Automatic loading paused by Stop. Select a profile and enable Load on startup to resume.':state.data.auto?'A saved profile will load on next startup.':'Automatic loading is off. Save current controls, then select and Load when needed.');
  }
  function selectProfile(){
    const id=ui.querySelector('#profile-select').value,state=profileStore?.refresh();
    profileSelection=state?.data.profiles.find(p=>p.id===id)||null;
    ui.querySelector('#profile-name').value=profileSelection?.name||'';
    ui.querySelector('#profile-network').checked=profileSelection?.networkConsent||false;
    profileNotice=profileSelection?'Selected '+profileSelection.name+'. Load applies its saved choices. Update replaces it with current controls.':'';renderProfiles();
  }
  function applyToolProfile(result,automatic=false){
    if(driftPending)throw Error('Wait for the current drift request to confirm or time out, then Load again. No profile was loaded.');
    if(dyno?.busy||dyno?.pending){dyno.cancel();throw Error('Tuner cancellation requested. Wait for the pending game request to finish, then Load again. A staged preset is not reverted.');}
    clearRaceOnlyAI();
    adaptiveRaceEnabled=false;if(ui)ui.querySelector('#adaptive-race').checked=false;clearCityPace();stopRubberband(true);
    suspend();driftNeedsReapply=false;dragTakenOver=false;lastShift=0;lastPulse=0;
    const choices=result.settings;
    for(const key of Object.keys(prefs))prefs[key]=choices[key];
    dynoEnabled=choices.dynoEnabled;dyno?.setEnabled(dynoEnabled);
    if(ui){ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').value=choices.dynoGoal;ui.querySelector('#profile-network').checked=result.profile.networkConsent;ui.querySelector('#profile-name').value=result.profile.name;}
    driftNeedsReapply=typeof prefs.drift==='boolean';profileDriftChoice=driftNeedsReapply;
    loadedProfile={id:result.profile.id,revision:result.profile.revision};savePrefs();syncProfileControls();
    dynoText=dynoEnabled?'Profile loaded. Open the solo Performance Tuning main screen. Existing staged presets are unchanged.':'Tuner off. Existing staged presets are unchanged.';updateDynoUI();
    profileNotice=(automatic?'Loaded on startup: ':'Loaded: ')+result.profile.name+'. Choices wait for verified game contexts.'+(result.profile.networkConsent?' Saved network permission restored where selected.':' Network permission and online no-clip remain off.')+' Game presets and drafts are not saved or restored by profiles.';
    message(profileNotice);renderProfiles();
  }
  function profileAction(action){
    if(profileActionPending)return;
    const request={stopToken:profileStore?.snapshot().stopToken,selection:profileSelection?{...profileSelection}:null,name:ui.querySelector('#profile-name').value,networkConsent:ui.querySelector('#profile-network').checked===true,auto:ui.querySelector('#profile-auto').checked,settings:{...prefs,dynoEnabled,dynoGoal:ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').value}};
    const epoch=profileActionEpoch;
    // localStorage has no atomic compare-and-swap. Serialize named-profile
    // writes across tabs with a browser-managed lock; Stop remains immediate
    // and its independent marker invalidates any stale startup authorization.
    const execute=()=>{
      if(epoch!==profileActionEpoch)return;
      if(action==='auto'){
        const latest=profileStore?.refresh();
        if(!latest?.available||latest.stopToken!==request.stopToken){profileNotice='Stop or profile storage changed while waiting. Select a profile and request startup loading again.';renderProfiles();return;}
      }
      performProfileAction(action,request);
    };
    if(action==='load'){execute();return;}
    const locks=profileLocks();
    if(!locks){profileNotice='Profile editing needs browser storage locking, which is unavailable. No profile was changed.';renderProfiles();return;}
    profileActionPending=true;renderProfiles();
    try{
      const result=locks.request('nfsu2-driving-tools-profiles-v1-write',execute);
      if(result&&typeof result.then==='function')result.catch(()=>{if(epoch===profileActionEpoch)profileNotice='Could not lock profile storage. No profile change was confirmed.';}).finally(()=>{if(epoch===profileActionEpoch){profileActionPending=false;renderProfiles();}});
      else {profileActionPending=false;renderProfiles();}
    }catch{profileActionPending=false;profileNotice='Could not lock profile storage. No profile change was confirmed.';renderProfiles();}
  }
  function performProfileAction(action,request){
    const selected=request.selection;
    try{
      if(!profileStore)throw Error('Profiles are unavailable.');
      if(action==='save'||action==='update'){
        if(action==='update'&&!selected)throw Error('Select a saved profile first.');
        const saved=profileStore.save({id:action==='update'?selected.id:null,revision:action==='update'?selected.revision:null,name:request.name,settings:request.settings,networkConsent:request.networkConsent});
        profileSelection=saved;profileNotice='Saved '+saved.name+' locally in this browser. This profile will not load on startup until explicitly enabled.';
      }else if(action==='load'){
        if(!selected)throw Error('Select a saved profile first.');
        applyToolProfile(profileStore.load(selected.id,selected.revision));return;
      }else if(action==='delete'){
        if(!selected)throw Error('Select a saved profile first.');
        profileStore.remove(selected.id,selected.revision);profileSelection=null;ui.querySelector('#profile-name').value='';ui.querySelector('#profile-network').checked=false;profileNotice='Saved profile deleted. Current controls are unchanged; automatic loading for it is off.';
      }else if(action==='auto'){
        const enabled=request.auto;
        if(enabled&&!selected)throw Error('Select a saved profile first.');
        profileStore.setAuto(enabled?selected.id:null,enabled?selected.revision:null);
        if(enabled){
          // Clear the fallback latch only AFTER the requested saved revision was
          // authorized successfully; a stale/failed enable must not erase Stop.
          try{sessionStorage.removeItem(PROFILE_SESSION_STOP);if(sessionStorage.getItem(PROFILE_SESSION_STOP)==='1')throw Error();}
          catch{try{profileStore.setAuto(null);}catch{}throw Error('Cannot clear the Stop pause in this tab. Automatic loading remains blocked here; check storage before retrying.');}
          profileSessionStopped=false;
        }
        profileNotice=enabled?'Load on startup enabled for '+selected.name+'. Its saved choices, including separately saved network permission, will be requested after reload. F9 pauses this.':'Automatic profile loading is off. Current controls are unchanged.';
      }
    }catch(error){profileNotice=error.message||'Profile action failed. Nothing was loaded.';message(profileNotice);}
    renderProfiles();
  }

- Preserves saved profiles, Street X, Drag protection, HUD/radar, camera controls, online opt-in, Stop/manual takeover and the stable Desktop folder. Live .9 handling, wall avoidance, race results and autonomous travel/join/race/return remain unverified.

Corner assistance remains free-roam-only and drag bypasses custom pace. No game assets, extracted binaries or research files are included.

# NFSU2 Driving Tools: experimental v0.38.9

## Handling evidence and selected city pace

Race pace + catch-up pairs a selected extra race pace P (1–2×) with an independent catch-up strength S (1–10×, quarter steps). Strength changes the assistance, not the speed target. The initial selections are pace2× and strength1×; these are authored controls, not a claim about the game's maximum. Loading follows an already selected Automatic/Race-only driver and does not acquire a manual car.

On exact AA/15e/943 builds, paired assistance follows the native physics path already selected by the game. Full physics uses four tire inputs; ordinary simplified AI physics uses its combined-grip input. This update corrects receiver identities and supports those paths separately without forcing a different physics mode. The native driver/car catch-up source caches remain unchanged. From original publication M, the handling scalar/aerodynamic divisor E is f32(f32(M×P)×S), and the nominal grip input is f32(E×P). Native modifiers remain in the combined-grip path. These are handling inputs, not measured engine power, tire grip, speed gains or a guarantee of winning.

Extra pace waits for current matching physical-input evidence. Full and simplified physics use different evidence kinds; requested pace, requested strength and verified application remain separate. The tools panel says requested pace while physical support is waiting. Bounded acknowledgement-rejection and native-stage codes enter the local log to distinguish failed identity/output checks from an unobserved publication. Owner, command, source factor, mode or permission changes revoke gain. Raised corner targets retain native use-time checks. When paired support is unavailable, the corner fallback uses the same neutral pace as the final target, avoiding an extra division by the selected pace. The base grade and braking tables remain planning assumptions, not load/contact measurements.

Online city clearance pacing keeps your explicitly selected free-roam factor as its ceiling, including values above 1×. Clear or unavailable observations retain that selection; an observed wall/vehicle hazard can reduce the runtime request and recovery moves back toward your ceiling. Unchanged observations no longer compound the same reduction on every page tick. Selected corner-planning pace stays stable while the separate city request changes, so the reduction does not rebuild the native driver. Existing exact-build online detection, current ownership, mode and permission checks remain. These partial observations do not establish route safety or collision avoidance.

Free-roam corner assist now compensates its approach-braking input by pace squared on these same three builds, matching its existing corner-speed compensation. Previously the braking hook skipped ordinary free roam while its target still received the selected extra pace. Actual native getter/approach fixtures at 1/1.5/2/3× prove the corrected approach envelope retains the native braking assumption. Lower/equal pace, race commands and special modes retain their existing paths. Ownership, route, table, mode, permission and use-time checks remain. This fixes a calculation mismatch; it does not prove that it caused an individual crash or change steering, traffic avoidance or recovery.

The streaming HUD and race hub use factual English track names, including Outer Ring, Bayview Plaza and Airport Circuit Track 5, for all 100 primary race IDs. The city is labelled Bayview. Unknown locations display as unavailable instead of internal track numbers. These names are a static factual projection of the user's existing game language table; no game language asset is packaged, and no new live memory reader is needed. Widget positions, sizing and Clean View keep their existing behavior.

The viewer HUD shows MPH, gear, RPM, location, places driven, top speed and driving time. MPH follows the native HUD's float32 conversion and truncation; it is the game's display convention. The session meter starts with this page and includes both manual and automatic free-roam/race driving. It credits only consecutive live samples no more than 500 ms apart, so hidden tabs, menus and invalid observations cannot add an unobserved gap. Saved race-history totals never become session records. Rear radar keeps its nearest distance and dot labels in game-distance coordinates without claiming independent metre calibration. Technical driving status remains in the tools panel.

Rotate camera is a separate toggle, off on reload. It requires Camera bound to C and uses that key at a random interval from 45 to 120 seconds during active driving. Menus, text entry, photo/drone mode, unfocused/hidden pages and changed sessions rearm a fresh interval. Pressing C postpones the next change; F7/F9 switch rotation off and release any automatic key pulse while preserving a real held C key. A current worker error also disables it. The toggle changes no performance settings and requires no online driving-tool permission. Timer and page-input fixtures are distinct from live camera verification.

## Racing and cornering

- v0.38.7 removes a node-spacing error: inserting redundant straight nodes no longer changes the target for an identical physical bend. Curvature uses canonical bends with bounded physical arms; gradual arcs and accumulated75° priority turns remain included. The lower-only corner target retains priority over added pace and physical requests. These are planning assumptions, not a measured collision-free racing line.
- On AA/15e/943, corrects the authored continuous corner blend that could lower an already suitable native target. Command3 now leaves a tiny, nonlimiting bend at its native ceiling and uses a lower-only curvature target for limiting bends, with pace compensation. Only the authored command3 expression changes; free-roam/Street X corner commands, native branch selection and all publisher/physics paths retain their prior code. Offline native cases include unchanged gentle bends and a curvature-at-limit example improving its requested target from27.55 to38 at a native ceiling40; these are target values, not a live speed measurement.
- Calculated mode removes the stacked80%/15% corner discounts and75% braking assumption from its forward node plan: it uses the native grade-table values, no extra distance reserve and the minimum100ms reaction required by the existing target lease. The native corner-record hook retains its supported95% factor with zero sharp-turn discount and full native braking. Saved custom sliders remain available to explicit Adaptive mode when calculated mode is off. Native factors above4 pass through unchanged but exceed the existing node-adapter eligibility range; node-cap coverage is unavailable there, rather than clamping native catch-up to4.
- Ordinary-race Adaptive keeps your selected native pace when optional corner records are absent. The previous policy could hold a 2× selection at 1×, with repeated partial clearance scans reducing it to 0.75×. Those heading-ray observations remain diagnostic for races; native braking and existing corner controls continue.
- The optional forward planner no longer treats the end of a preview as a stopping obstacle or imposes a fixed straight-road ceiling. A straight or unsupported preview leaves native driving in control. Zero, negative and nonfinite optional caps cannot stop the native target.
- On exact **8abf9be8, 93cfc6e9, aa2429fb, 15e5958f and 943ee537**, node lookahead can use a game-thread receipt of the game's own grade-dependent grip and braking tables. It measures gradual and accumulated 75°+ bends on original checked road anchors, rather than creating extra curvature at interpolation knots. Its maximum horizon is 512 native route units, clipped to the actual checked source and the unchanged 24-anchor/40-node budgets; a short source stays short. A measured bend supplies a braking envelope; passing its anchor alone is not treated as proof of corner exit. The outgoing-heading release rule is authored assistance, not an unchanged native algorithm.

- Free-roam corner assistance now compensates for the selected pace. A 2× boost no longer doubles an assisted corner target. Previously ignored sampled gentle bends are checked when increased pace makes them limiting. Changing a boosted planning pace rebuilds the cached native route once; sub-native runtime changes share the original 1× plan. This still needs a usable native corner sample and does not prove that every free-roam turn is covered.

## Streaming display and rear radar

Shift+Insert hides controls, hub, launcher, Stop buttons, old Info HUD and the game's detailed performance column. Only selected Streaming HUD and rear radar remain. A second Shift+Insert restores the prior controls; F8 opens the menu. F7/manual and F9/Stop remain effective. Text-field paste is preserved.

The radar's native blink-out flag is one byte. Reading four bytes could reject visible cars because neighboring native state was nonzero; both local and peer checks now read the byte. Solo and opted-in online fixtures cover this correction. The radar observes locally loaded cars behind you, shows the nearest eight within the selected 50–500 native-unit range, and retains ownership, commitment, list and freshness guards. It does not identify rivals or guarantee all online cars are loaded. Its live readings remain to be verified.

## Using the update

Keep the existing Desktop\NFSU2-Driving-Tools folder as the single unpacked extension location. Load this version into the existing extension, then refresh the game; a full Chrome restart was previously necessary to replace a retained older content script. Check the displayed version before testing.

For road races, use Automatic driver or Race-only automatic driver. Race pace + catch-up follows that driver by default on its supported builds, enabling the existing ordinary-race shortcut eligibility policy and corrected corner targets. Set pace and strength separately. Native probability, category, direction and checkpoint rules still decide whether a shortcut is taken; installed/requested flags are not evidence of taking one. Turn paired assistance off to use the custom Adaptive ceiling/corner sliders. For boosted free roam, enable Free-roam corner assist so its compensated native targets are requested. Online operation still requires Allow network tools. Stop remains available, and F9 works in Clean View.

The session-only City clearance pacing choice follows the explicit free-roam pace selection, from 0.75× to 3×, through initial acquisition and reacquisition. ## v0.33.0: Continuous adaptive corner targets

Adaptive road-race speed now has a separate native planning command. Every valid sampled nonzero bend receives a smooth curvature-based target, instead of requiring it to cross the older curvature threshold. Exact straights keep the requested target ceiling; existing native lower/stop results are never increased. The native distance-based braking calculation uses the same pace compensation.

The curve is deliberately conservative and experimental. It does not detect every corner on the map: the native planner may provide no corner records, skip a tail record, report zero curvature or use another route. It does not change steering, physical brakes, route lookahead, NOS or other cars. A hook hit is an observation of a past call, not proof the current corner is safe. Five fresh captures show hook hits despite reported missed turns, so the update is not presented as a proven fix for every failure.

Only adaptive road mode uses this new command. **Street X and existing free-roam/road-corner controls retain their exact prior behavior.** The new command also denies actual/forced Street X and known online Street X in its native guards. AI ownership, native handback, online permission, mode checks and watchdog remain required. This does not bypass an AI failure or acquire control automatically.

The option remains default-off/session-only and uses your current sliders without changing saved values. For the first comparison, try the existing defaults: 1.30× adaptive ceiling, 0.80 corner factor and 0.75 braking factor. Higher targets can still cause missed turns. The latest logs used 1.90×, 0.95 and 1.00 respectively; those settings were confirmed, not shown to be safe. Keep the working Street X setup unchanged.

Corner/braking hit counters now use the existing two-second telemetry sample cadence instead of replacing bounded history every quarter second. Discrete control/mode changes still log promptly. No raw route geometry, memory dump or additional personal data is collected.

Native tests execute the new corner and braking hooks against the pinned game routines, compare legacy commands byte-for-byte, and check protected outputs and guard denials. Live cornering, race results and browser rendering remain unverified. The final combined suite passes **1,942 tests, zero failures/skips/cancellations**. All four supported patched modules compile, with only the two reviewed corner/braking wrapper functions changed from v0.32.

It does not find, join, start, replay or vote for events.

The race-only switch is **off by default**, stays armed between races on this page, and resets on page reload or profile Load. It is deliberately not added to saved profiles; existing saved choices and storage remain unchanged.

**F7, F9/Stop, or driving-key takeover during a race disarms race-only AI.** Manual steering in free roam leaves it armed. If driving controls are still physically held when entering a race, acquisition waits until they are released. Turning the switch off requests native handback. ## Optional adaptive road-race speed

A new **default-off, session-only** option coordinates the existing native route planner. Its separate straight-target ceiling defaults to **1.30×** and ranges from 1.00× to 2.00×. The native route uses distance to known corners to lower its target in advance while retaining a higher target on sufficiently long straights. This is a planned target factor, not a physical speed cap or a measured speed increase.

Enable either **Race-only automatic driver** or **Automatic driver**, then **Adaptive road-race speed** in AI driver → Road-race settings. Online use also requires **Allow network tools**. Adaptive mode uses the existing Race corner speed, Race sharp-turn margin and Race braking factor values, even when the separate Road-race hairpin assist switch is off. Lower braking factor requests earlier braking. It overrides the effective custom race pace only in eligible ordinary road races, without changing any saved switch or slider.

**Street X keeps the exact existing pace, corner and braking selections.** Adaptive mode is dormant in actual/forced Street X and the known online Street X mode. Drag, Drift/forced variants, Outrun and free roam are also excluded. Selecting adaptive mode does not turn on Automatic driver or network permission.

The optional ceiling stays constant while driving. The existing native route envelope varies by distance; JavaScript does not switch pace or reconstruct the driver at every corner. A deliberate setting or race-mode change may still require the existing OFF/acknowledgement/ON route reconstruction. Manual takeover, race end, permission withdrawal and the existing watchdog remain in force.

F7/manual driving keys stop AI and leave the optional selection dormant. F9/Stop, profile Load and page reload turn adaptive mode off. It is not added to saved tool profiles or legacy session preferences. Blur, hidden page and menus pause it normally. Turn it off to return to the prior controls after native handoff.

The HUD and local log distinguish a request, matching native pace acknowledgement, and observed corner/braking hook evidence. These counters do not measure braking success, safe corner entry or a clean lap. There is no new steering, obstacle avoidance, NOS control, added route horizon, opponent manipulation or collision protection. Higher targets can still cause crashes. Start at 1.30× and assess one change at a time.

The original v0.32 option used page orchestration only. The v0.33 continuous-corner update changes the two native planner wrappers and teaches the controller a separate adaptive command. Existing planner commands retain their prior behavior; engine tuning, NOS, Drag-retention, tuner and saved-profile implementations are untouched. Exact-native synthetic tests support the route-speed envelope; live racing, lap times, wins and browser layout remain unverified.

## Retained v0.28.0: Correct the online Unlimited NOS clock

Unlimited NOS now refreshes an already-active NOS timestamp using the same clock the native game selected. The corrected code retains the burst in that exact native test.

Inactive and sentinel timestamps remain inactive; network permission and current-car/kit checks remain mandatory.

The new log samples the selected clock, active-since stamp and kit/resource accounting **before refill**; it contains no pointers. The timestamp flag does not prove successful activation, and sampled logs can miss short transitions.
